accesskey.description: Defines a shortcut key to focus and activate an element (typically with an aditional modifier key based on browser), value is a single character that is the shortcut key.

class.description: One or more class names defined as a class style.

contenteditable.description: Specifies whether the element's content is editable, and whether rich formatting is allowed.

data-*.description: Stores custom data on the element as data-<name>="<value>".

dir.description: Defines text direction of the content.

draggable.description: Defines whether this element is draggable, often used for drag and drop operations.

enterkeyhint.description: Allows the appearence of the enter key to be different on mobile.

hidden.description: Boolean attribute that hides the element.

id.description: Defines a unique identifier for the element.

inert.description: Disables element and all inner elements.

inputmode.description: Defines the input mode for the element when the keyboard is active.

lang.description: Defines the language of the content.

popover.description: Makes the element a popover, hidden until shown by a popovertarget button or the popover API.

spellcheck.description: Defines whether the element should have spell checking enabled or not.

style.description: Defines the style of the element.

tabindex.description: Defines the tab order of the element.

title.description: Defines the title of the element, typically shown as a tooltip hint.

translate.description: Defines whether the content should be translated or not.

role.description: The ARIA role of the element, describing its purpose to assistive technology.

slot.description: The name of the shadow DOM slot the element is assigned to.

part.description: Space-separated part names, exposing the element to ::part() from outside its shadow tree.

exportparts.description: Re-exports parts of nested shadow trees so they can be styled with ::part().

is.description: The name of the customized built-in element this element should be upgraded to.

nonce.description: Cryptographic nonce used by Content Security Policy to allow the element's script or style.

autofocus.description: Boolean attribute that focuses the element when the page loads or its dialog/popover opens.

autocapitalize.description: How virtual keyboards capitalise text entered into the element.

autocorrect.description: Whether the browser may auto-correct text entered into the element.

itemscope.description: Boolean attribute that starts a new microdata item.

itemtype.description: Space-separated URLs of the vocabulary used for the microdata item.

itemid.description: The global identifier of the microdata item.

itemprop.description: Space-separated microdata property names this element supplies.

itemref.description: Space-separated ids of elements outside the item that also supply its properties.

writingsuggestions.description: Whether the browser may offer writing suggestions in the element.

virtualkeyboardpolicy.description: Whether the virtual keyboard is shown automatically on editable elements.

hidden:1.description: Hides the element until it is revealed by find-in-page or fragment navigation (hidden="until-found").
